catalogue_scope.construction: Actual subgroup of the split eight-dimensional orthogonal group over a cubic extension K/F, generated by four literal triality-folded root families
catalogue_scope.parameters: F and K finite fields, Algebra F K, [K:F]=3; q=|F|, |K|=q^3; every prime power q>=2
catalogue_scope.exceptions: None: the same matrix model is nonabelian simple also at q=2 and in characteristic three
catalogue_scope.recognition: Direct pinned triality-folded matrix construction; no recognition from order. Full related-triple graph-field fixed-point comparison and generalized-hexagon axioms are not claimed
catalogue_scope.attribution: Explicit D4 root matrices, cubic Frobenius folding, twelve-cell Bruhat coordinates, SL2/trace perfectness and the solvable-radical Iwasawa criterion
